title.ja: 写真を撮ってと頼まれる

summary.ja: 観光客に写真を頼まれて、立ち位置を伝えたり撮り方を確認したりする。
summary.en: Tourists ask you to take their photo: check the phone, tell them where to stand and take a few.

setting: In front of a large temple gate in Kyoto, on a busy autumn afternoon. Two tourists, Emma and a friend, want a photo of themselves with the gate behind them.

roles.persona: A Japanese person visiting the temple on their day off.

levels.tutor: You are Emma, a tourist with a friend. Speak slowly and simply. Ask the local to take a photo of you two, hand over your phone, and say thank you at the end.

hints: こころよく引き受けましょう
Sure, no …
Sure, no problem.
押すボタンを確認しましょう
Is it this …?
Is it this button?
カウントしてから撮りましょう
Okay, smile! One, two, …!
Okay, smile! One, two, three!

levels.tutor: You are Emma, a tourist with a friend, speaking at natural pace. Ask for a photo with the gate behind you. Stand a little far apart until the local asks you to move, and be happy to take another if they offer.

hints: こころよく引き受けましょう
Sure. Is it …?
Sure. Is it this white button?
縦で撮るか横で撮るか聞きましょう
Do you want it … or …?
Do you want it vertical or horizontal?

title.ja: 立ち位置をお願いする

hints: もう少し近づくようお願いしましょう
Could you move a bit …?
Could you move a bit closer together?

title.ja: 写真を確認してもらう

hints: スマホを返して、これでいいか聞きましょう
Here you go. Is …?
Here you go. Is this okay?

levels.tutor: You are Emma, a friendly tourist with a friend, speaking at natural speed with a little small talk. You'd like the whole gate in the photo. Another visitor is standing just behind you on your left, in the shot, and you haven't noticed. Follow the local's suggestions about where to stand, and look through the photos happily at the end.

hints: 門が全部入る場所を提案しましょう
Sure. If you stand …, you'll get …
Sure. If you stand over there, you'll get the whole gate in.

title.ja: 立ち位置をていねいに直す

hints: 後ろに人がいるので、少し動いてもらいましょう
Could you move a little to the …? There's …
Could you move a little to the right? There's someone behind you.
人を大きく撮るか、門を大きく撮るか聞きましょう
Do you want … or more of …?
Do you want a close-up, or more of the gate?

title.ja: 何枚か撮ったと伝える

hints: 何枚か撮ったので選んでと伝えましょう
I took a few, so you can …
I took a few, so you can choose the best one.

roles.persona: Emma, a tourist visiting the temple with a friend.

levels.tutor: You are a kind local visiting the temple. Speak slowly and simply. Say yes when asked for a photo, check which button to press, and count before you take it.

hints: 写真を撮ってもらえるか聞きましょう
Excuse me, could you take …?
Excuse me, could you take a photo?
押すボタンを教えましょう
Press …
Press this button.
お礼を言いましょう
Thank you …!
Thank you so much!

levels.tutor: You are a kind local visiting the temple, speaking at natural pace. Take the photo, ask whether they want it vertical or horizontal, and hand the phone back.

title.ja: 撮りたい写真を伝えてお願いする
title.en: Ask for the photo you want

hints: 門が後ろに入るように撮ってほしいと伝えましょう
Could you take a photo of us with …?
Could you take a photo of us with the gate behind us?

title.ja: スマホの使い方を伝える

hints: 白い丸をタップするだけと伝えましょう
Just tap …
Just tap the white circle.
縦がいいか横がいいか答えましょう
Vertical / Horizontal, please.
Vertical, please.
もう1枚お願いしましょう
Could you take …?
Could you take one more, please?

levels.tutor: You are a kind local visiting the temple, speaking at natural speed with a little small talk. Take the photos carefully. When they offer to take one of you, accept happily.

title.ja: ていねいにお願いする

hints: ていねいに写真をお願いしましょう
Sorry to bother you. Would you mind …?
Sorry to bother you. Would you mind taking a picture of us?

title.ja: 撮り方の希望を伝える

hints: 門全体を入れてほしいと伝えましょう
Could you get … in?
Could you get the whole gate in?
縦でもう1枚お願いしましょう
Could you take … as well?
Could you take a vertical one as well?
お礼に、相手の写真も撮ろうかと聞きましょう
Would you like me to …?
Would you like me to take one of you too?
